parameters.query:
INSERT INTO raw_events (source, external_ref, payload, payload_hash)
VALUES ('bitrix_webhook', $1, $2::jsonb, encode(digest($2::text,'sha256'),'hex'))
ON CONFLICT (source, payload_hash) DO NOTHING
RETURNING raw_id;

nodes.name: Land raw (idempotent)
nodes.notes: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING means a redelivered webhook returns zero rows and the branch below stops. Replay always starts from here, never from Bitrix.

nodes.name: Parse & compute metrics
nodes.notes: Normalisation, phone E.164 and every computed metric happen in Python. n8n never does arithmetic that ends up in a score.

parameters.query:
WITH up AS (
  INSERT INTO interactions (
    external_source, external_id, channel, started_at, ended_at,
    customer_phone_raw, customer_phone_e164, is_bot_handled,
    handled_by, message_count, customer_message_count, agent_message_count,
    first_response_seconds, is_after_hours
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3::channel, $4::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz,
    $6, $7, $8::boolean,
    CASE WHEN $8::boolean THEN 'bot' ELSE 'agent' END::speaker_role,
    $9::int, $10::int, $11::int, $12::int, $13::boolean
  )
  ON CONFLICT (external_source, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
    ended_at = EXCLUDED.ended_at,
    message_count = EXCLUDED.message_count,
    customer_message_count = EXCLUDED.customer_message_count,
    agent_message_count = EXCLUDED.agent_message_count,
    first_response_seconds = EXCLUDED.first_response_seconds,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING interaction_id
)
SELECT interaction_id FROM up;

INSERT INTO chat_messages (interaction_id, seq, sender, body, sent_at)
SELECT $1::uuid,
       (m->>'seq')::int,
       (m->>'sender')::speaker_role,
       m->>'body',
       (m->>'sent_at')::timestamptz
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) AS m
ON CONFLICT (interaction_id, sender, sent_at, body_hash) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: Insert messages (dedup)
nodes.notes: The webhook resends the WHOLE thread every time. The unique key on (interaction_id, sender, sent_at, body_hash) is what stops five webhooks becoming five copies of every message.

nodes.name: Human agent involved?
nodes.notes: Bot-only threads stop here. Grading a human on the qualification bot's messages makes every QA number wrong.

nodes.name: Wait for thread to settle
nodes.notes: A conversation grows over days. Re-running the judge on every webhook is expensive and produces churn; this waits until the thread has been idle before spending a model call.

parameters.query:
SELECT count(*) AS newer
FROM chat_messages
WHERE interaction_id = $1::uuid
  AND sent_at > $2::timestamptz;

nodes.name: Newer messages arrived?
nodes.notes: If the thread grew while we waited, a later run will evaluate the fuller version. Abandoning this run avoids paying twice and avoids a stale score overwriting a fresh one.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ conversation: $('Parse & compute metrics').item.json.transcript_text, input_type: 'chat', metadata: $('Parse & compute metrics').item.json.metrics, run_pass1: true, run_pass2: true }) }}

nodes.name: Two AI passes
nodes.notes: One HTTP call, two separate DeepSeek requests inside. Pass 1 (customer) and pass 2 (agent) never see each other's output.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_evaluations (
  interaction_id, schema_version, prompt_version, rubric_version, model,
  input_type, final_score, performance_level, weight_applied,
  m1_reception, m2_offer, m3_objections, m4_followup, m5_closing,
  breakdown, evidence, stage_reached, objections_found, behavior_flags,
  top_strength, top_weakness, top_recommendation, notes, raw_response
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, '1.0', $2, $3, $4, 'chat'::input_type,
  $5::numeric, $6, $7::numeric,
  $8::numeric, $9::numeric, $10::numeric, $11::numeric, $12::numeric,
  $13::jsonb, $14::jsonb, $15::conversation_stage, $16::jsonb, $17::jsonb,
  $18, $19, $20, $21, $22::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (interaction_id) DO UPDATE SET
  final_score = EXCLUDED.final_score,
  performance_level = EXCLUDED.performance_level,
  weight_applied = EXCLUDED.weight_applied,
  m1_reception = EXCLUDED.m1_reception, m2_offer = EXCLUDED.m2_offer,
  m3_objections = EXCLUDED.m3_objections, m4_followup = EXCLUDED.m4_followup,
  m5_closing = EXCLUDED.m5_closing,
  breakdown = EXCLUDED.breakdown, evidence = EXCLUDED.evidence,
  raw_response = EXCLUDED.raw_response, updated_at = now();

nodes.name: 200 OK
nodes.notes: Answer Bitrix immediately. A webhook sender must never wait on ASR or a model call.
